claim: In 2012, an 11-set Venn diagram that met those criteria was discovered, and another with 13 sets was found in 2014.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: [AI label: Claude, 2026-10-06 - not yet checked by the human annotator] Mamakani and Ruskey, 'A New Rose: The First Simple Symmetric 11-Venn Diagram' (arXiv, 27 Jul 2012); the 13-curve diagrams are in their 'New Roses: Simple Symmetric Venn Diagrams with 11 and 13 Curves' (Discrete & Computational Geometry, 2014). Dzoba's preprint (22 Sep 2026): simple symmetric ones 'were known only up to 13 curves (Mamakani and Ruskey, 2014)'. 2014 is the publication year; whether the 13-curve diagrams were found earlier was not established.
